subject: Taxes
title: CBDCs and Tax Automation
description: One-minute skill: CBDCs and Tax Automation.

hook.text: Central Bank Digital Currencies could make tax collection automatic.

buildup.text: China's digital yuan tracks every payment. The government can see every purchase, transfer.

discovery.text: With a CBDC, the government could calculate and deduct taxes automatically from every transaction.

twist.text: Privacy advocates call this financial surveillance.

climax.text: CBDCs offer perfect tax compliance at the cost of total financial transparency.

punchline.text: Automatic tax, zero privacy. CBDCs make evasion impossible.

quiz.question: What could CBDCs enable for tax collection?
options: Automatic real-time tax deduction from every transaction
